description: Generic record schema. Works for any listing, article, directory or table.

id.note: Stable across runs: source id, URL, or a hash of the record.

url.note: Absolute link to the item detail page, when one exists.

title.note: Headline of the record as the site presents it.

price.note: Numeric amount only, no currency symbols. Null when the site has no price.

currency.note: ISO code when known, otherwise the symbol or text shown.

description.note: Short summary or the listing body, cleaned of HTML.

attributes.note: Every other semantic field found on the item, snake_case keys. This is where domain-specific data lives (author, mileage, bedrooms, rating, ...).
